digest.component_or_area: dependency advisory gating and CI lane logic
propositions: A committed lock causes transitive-dependency advisories to gate all in-flight changes indiscriminately, blocking authors who made no dependency change and cannot fix the issue.
The pip-audit job must differentiate between Gerrit verify (block only changes that touch the dependency map) and scheduled main (block all, escalate to ticket, gate releases).

override-dependencies is the correct remediation instrument when an upstream cap blocks an upgrade; constraint-dependencies can only narrow and returns UNSATISFIABLE as expected output, not as proof of impossibility.
A periodic canary must track outstanding advisories, file/update a single ticket per advisory with dedup, and close it when the advisory clears, following the heartbeat-canary precedent.
Severity thresholds must apply (CRITICAL/HIGH fail, MEDIUM warn, LOW track) with unrated advisories treated as HIGH to prevent silent ignores.
